detail:
Every key below is a NEW checker finding judged MODEL-GAP by code reading (not a host defect). Evidence file:line is current at lane/lock-model-gaps + lock-host-fix-2.

GAP 1 - thread-start lambda also attributed to the spawner (inflated actor counts). Mis-step: actors of a make-thread lambda body include the spawning function; a 'main' actor arrives via the mux start->stop-loop failure path (mux.lisp:1792). Fix: attribute a thread lambda only to its thread actor; keep the failure-path call as its own actor only if reachable concurrently.
  R1b|fnn-bpnode-test-busy-p|*fnn-bpnode-test-busy-answers*:unlocked-write (bp-node.lisp:37-44, callback on the node-loop thread)
  R1b|fnn-mux-cleanup-debt|fnn-mux-loop-cleanup-debts:unlocked-write (mux.lisp:304)
  R1b|fnn-mux-finish|fnn-mux-loop-conns:unlocked-write (mux.lisp:449)
  R1b|fnn-extent-decoded-window-span-octet|fnn-cold-worker-span:unlocked-write (extent-decoded.lisp:48,87; also gap 7)

GAP 2 - no quiescence after thread death. Mis-step: fnn-mux-drained-p (mux.lisp:460-473) reads closed/inbox/arrived/conns/cleanup-debts/wake fds after (not (thread-alive-p)); every in-loop access of closed/inbox/arrived at the flagged lines (mux.lisp:1008, 1551, 1713) is itself inside with-mutex of the loop lock (read this lane), so the only unlocked reads are the post-death ones (caller owner.lisp:8890-8904 after modules-joined). Fix: model thread-alive-p-false / joined as a quiescence guard for reads of that thread's confined state.
  R1b|lambda@host/native/mux.lisp:fnn-mux-await#lambda1|fnn-mux-loop-arrived:unlocked-read
  R1b|fnn-mux-take-inbox|fnn-mux-loop-inbox:unlocked-read
  R1b|fnn-mux-stop-loop|fnn-mux-loop-closed:unlocked-read

GAP 3 - write before make-thread (happens-before spawn). Mis-step: no hb edge from a write that precedes the spawn to the spawned thread; prototype /tmp/lmg-hb-prototype.py clears nothing real because fnn-pull-service-start / mux/pull/web lambdas are passed as #'ref (no call edge) and mux wake write+spawn share a dolist. Fix: funcall-of-parameter / #'ref dataflow, then hb-before-spawn pruning.
  R1b|fnn-mux-start|fnn-mux-loop-wake-read:unlocked-write (mux.lisp:1771)
  R1b|fnn-mux-start|fnn-mux-loop-wake-write:unlocked-write (mux.lisp:1771)
  R1b|fnn-extent-decoded-storage-start|fnn-cold-worker-decoded-storage:unlocked-write (extent-decoded.lisp:130, read on executor thread :264)
  R1b|fnn-owner-peer-flight-startup|fnn-owner-service-peer-flight-bank:unlocked-write (owner.lisp:8648 before workers start :8704)

GAP 5 - no publication row (unlocked_publication empty): set-once / owner-published / idempotent memo. Fix: add publication rows (contract) with a stated discipline, or model set-once-before-publish.
  R1b|fnn-constants|*fnn-constants*:unlocked-write (io.lisp:2022-2036, idempotent memo)
  R1b|fnn-owner-claim-run-authority|*fnn-owner-retained-service*:unlocked-read (owner.lisp:978-1001; writers under Q)
  R1b|fnn-owner-output-install|fnn-owner-service-output-ledger:unlocked-read (owner.lisp:1943-1951 set once, reads :2016,:2034)

GAP 6 residual - :synchronized table not a protector (cleared as write; residual unlocked-read key remains).
  R1b|fnn-owner-measure-note|*fnn-owner-measure-table*:unlocked-read (owner.lisp:542; writes under SYNC:)

GAP 7 - exclusion by ACL2 state / custody handoff. Mis-step: guard is the ACL2 gate (fn-lgc-rotate-admitsp io.lisp:8440) or a token holder, not a mutex. Fix: a contract row naming the state-machine/custody guard.
  R1b|fnn-log-close-active|fnn-log-fd:unlocked-write (io.lisp:8352-8355)
  R1b|fnn-log-close-active|fnn-log-active-close-debt:unlocked-write (io.lisp:8352-8355)
  R1b|fnn-extent-executor-actual-return|fnn-cold-worker-phase:unlocked-read (extent.lisp:433,547,559,712,803,879,998,1106; token holder, E re-acquired)

GAP 8 - globals used only inside an O quantum via fnn-live-arena but not declared guarded-by O (stop-time unlocked readers bp-service.lisp:1473, io.lisp:1707, owner.lisp:8592 unproved). Fix: declare guarded-by O (contract) after proving the stop-time readers.
  R1b|fnn-seal-live-buffer|*fnn-staged-handle*:unlocked-write (io.lisp:1921)
  R1b|fnn-arena-release-due|*fnn-arena-release-custody*:unlocked-write (io.lisp:7837)
  R1b|fnn-log-reseat-fenced|fnn-log-reseat-custody:unlocked-write (io.lisp:7871/7884)

GAP 10 - manual grab-mutex with timed condition-wait unresolved; W->W claim ignores (unless (holding-mutex-p lock) ...). Fix: resolve grab-mutex lock identity (as with-mutex) and honour the holding-mutex-p guard.
  R5|fnn-feed-idle-wait|unresolved:manual grab-mutex of W (x2 records, feed-service.lisp:701,709)
  R5|fnn-pull-idle-wait|unresolved:manual grab-mutex of W (pull-service.lisp:1075)
  R5|fnn-pull-ready-wait|unresolved:manual grab-mutex of XPWAKE (pull-service.lisp)
  R5|lambda@host/native/owner.lisp:fnn-owner-start-maintenance#lambda1|W->W (owner.lisp:8484)
  R5|lambda@host/native/owner.lisp:fnn-owner-start-maintenance#lambda1|unresolved:manual grab-mutex of W (owner.lisp:8484)

GAP R9 dead-path - R9 reports an await path in the mux loop that is not reachable as a blocking hold. Fix: reachability pruning for the observed condition-wait wrapper (lr2 'R9 mux-loop await (2)').
  R9|fnn-observed-condition-wait|mux-loop:await:sb-thread:condition-wait (2 records)

GAP inspector binding - R2 unresolved callable binding. Mis-step: control.lisp:239 funcall of a parameter (binding) from the inspect-answer path under O cannot be resolved to the registered inspector set. Fix: resolve the registered inspector binding set (funcall-of-parameter dataflow, as gap 3).
  R2|fnn-control-live-status-answer|unresolved:binding (control.lisp:239)

GAP R7 funcall-of-parameter escape - handler classifies via fn-fs-classify and calls the ESCAPE parameter (owner.lisp:1726-1736), which callers supply as the fence; the checker cannot see the funcall target. Fix: same dataflow, or per-caller escape resolution.
  R7|fnn-owner-actor-run|swallow:serious-condition:fault (owner.lisp:1726)

GAP R7 value-routed deferred rethrow - fnn-store-indeterminate is returned as :uncertain (bp-node.lisp:218-228) and rethrown as fnn-indeterminate by the caller (bp-node.lisp:339-341). Same class as LOCK-R7-PULL-WORKER-DEBT-RETHROW. Fix: recognise a returned-status sentinel later converted to a signal.
  R7|fnn-bpnode-app-result|swallow:fnn-store-indeterminate:indet

GAP R7 diagnostic-only protected form - the swallowed form is logging or tracing whose failure is stated not to alter custody (io.lisp:1101 after the debt is already pushed under the queue mutex; owner.lisp:1892 docstring). Fix: contract list of diagnostic sinks (fnn-err / fnn-owner-custody-trace) exempt from R7, or a typed diagnostic marker.
  R7|fnn-log-physical-close|swallow:ignore-errors:fault
  R7|fnn-owner-custody-trace|swallow:serious-condition:fault
fix: Checker lane: implement the fix direction per gap, re-run --check, and drop or re-baseline the listed keys. Not host defects; no host change implied.
